Raise ValueError when a feature revises past output after seeing future rows.

By default every nonempty proper prefix is checked; use small fixtures.

source_files.docstring:
Explicit CSV parsing and lossless-row diagnostic normalization to UTC.

Invalid numeric tokens become NaN and invalid timestamps become NaT. Their
original row numbers and tokens are retained in the load diagnostics. No rows
are sorted, removed, or filled. Diagnostic output is not research-ready data.

definitions.docstring: Parsed rows and bounded diagnostics; row positions are one-based CSV data rows.

definitions.name: sha256_file

definitions.name: read_metadata
definitions.docstring: Read versioned JSON metadata. Each important field needs explicit confirmation.

definitions.name: metadata_blockers
definitions.docstring: List unresolved research requirements; never trust filename hints as facts.

definitions.name: load_csv
definitions.docstring:
Parse CSV using declared encoding (unix_s/ms/us/ns, aware, or local).

'aware' and 'local' require an explicit strptime timestamp_format. Local
timestamps additionally require source_timezone; ambiguous/nonexistent DST
times become NaT and are reported. Unconfirmed timestamp assumptions are
allowed only in diagnostic mode. Numeric volume units remain metadata-only.

definitions.name: validate_expected_timestamps
definitions.docstring:
Validate an independently generated, exact-window trading schedule.

This checks the schedule's contract, not its authenticity: callers must
construct it from a confirmed calendar and the requested date boundaries.

definitions.name: validate_data
definitions.docstring:
Report row defects, same-UTC-day gaps and optional calendar coverage.

Duplicate counts count all participating rows. OHLC comparisons apply only
to rows with finite prices. Gaps are candidates, not proven missing candles:
cross-day intervals are ignored by the simple gap policy. Callers may
optionally supply an authoritative expected UTC timestamp index for this
exact window. It must be generated independently of the observed rows.

source_files.docstring: Small validation and alignment helpers shared by indicator modules.
Nơi định nghĩa các chỉ báo tự thiết kế, Price Action và cấu trúc thị trường.

Causal market structure heuristics, published on confirmation bars.

BOS/CHoCH/MSS and zones have no unique industry definition. The definitions
below are explicit research features, not order instructions.

definitions.name: confirmed_swings
definitions.docstring:
Strict local extrema, emitted right bars after pivot, never backdated.

First possible observation is at left+right. Tied extrema do not qualify.
Missing windows and non-events return NaN; values are pivot prices.

definitions.name: swing_structure
definitions.docstring:
HH/LH and HL/LL at confirmation; nullable until two same-kind pivots.

Non-pivot bars are False after a prior pivot; equality is neither HH nor LH.

definitions.name: structure_breaks
definitions.docstring:
Close breaks last unbroken confirmed level (strict crossing).

Trend initializes on first break. Same-direction break=BOS; opposite=CHoCH.
MSS is CHoCH with real body/range >= displacement_ratio. Each pivot level
is consumed once. Levels confirmed on current bar are eligible next bar.
Direction is +1/-1, zero means no event; missing OHLC produces NaN.

definitions.name: support_resistance_zones
definitions.docstring:
Last confirmed pivot +/- relative tolerance; NaN until first pivot.

These are single-pivot zones, not retrospectively clustered levels.

definitions.name: previous_period_levels
definitions.docstring:
Previous observed calendar day/week OHLC in explicit timezone.

Index must be unique, ordered UTC. Week starts Monday. Current incomplete
period is never used. First observed period is NaN. A prior partial period
remains partial: caller must supply validated complete session coverage.

definitions.name: daily_pivots
definitions.docstring:
Previous-day traditional/Fibonacci/Camarilla/CPR pivot levels.

NaN for first day; uses previous_period_levels coverage assumptions.

definitions.name: fibonacci_retracement
definitions.docstring:
Retracement from latest confirmed high/low; direction from newest pivot.

New high: H-ratio*(H-L); new low: L+ratio*(H-L). Both pivots required.

definitions.name: equal_high_low
definitions.docstring: Successive confirmed same-kind pivots within relative tolerance.

definitions.name: liquidity_sweep
definitions.docstring: Wick crosses previous confirmed level but close returns strictly inside.

definitions.name: fair_value_gap
definitions.docstring:
Three-bar wick gap emitted on third close; bounds NaN on non-events.

Bullish: current low > high two bars ago; bearish: current high < old low.
No additional displacement or gap-mitigation assumptions.

source_files.docstring: Causal momentum and oscillator indicators.

definitions.name: rsi
definitions.docstring:
Wilder RSI with SMA seed of window changes (window+1 prices).

No loss => 100; no gain => 0; both zero => NaN. Missing change restarts
smoothing warm-up. Output percentage is aligned to current completed bar.

definitions.name: macd
definitions.docstring:
Fast EMA - slow EMA, signal EMA and histogram in price units.

First-sample EMA seeds; line needs slow samples, signal slow+signal-1.
Missing values reset each EMA. Require fast < slow.

definitions.name: stochastic
definitions.docstring:
Fast %K=100*(C-min L)/(max H-min L), %D=SMA(%K,smooth).

Needs window bars then smooth valid K values; flat range returns NaN.

definitions.name: stochastic_rsi
definitions.docstring:
0..100 RSI stochastic; K=SMA(raw,smooth), D=SMA(K,smooth).

K needs rsi_window+stoch_window+smooth-1 prices, D another smooth-1.
Flat RSI range produces NaN; all rolling windows require full coverage.

definitions.name: roc
definitions.docstring: 100*(C/C.shift(window)-1); window+1 prices, zero base -> NaN.

definitions.name: momentum
definitions.docstring: C-C.shift(window) in price units; window+1 prices, no NaN fill.

definitions.name: cci
williams_r
definitions.docstring: -100*(max H-C)/(max H-min L), window bars; flat range -> NaN.

definitions.name: ppo
definitions.docstring: Percentage MACD, same EMA seeds/warm-up; zero slow EMA -> NaN.

definitions.name: tsi
definitions.docstring:
100*double-EMA(change)/double-EMA(abs(change)).

Needs long+short prices, EMA first-sample seeds; flat denominator -> NaN.

definitions.name: awesome_oscillator
definitions.docstring: Fast SMA - slow SMA of (H+L)/2; slow bars; missing window -> NaN.

source_files.docstring: Moving averages. Warm-up observations are NaN and no input is mutated.

definitions.name: sma
definitions.docstring: Simple moving average; first window - 1 values are NaN.

definitions.name: ema
definitions.docstring:
Pandas EWM, seeded at first sample, hidden until window samples.

adjust=False uses alpha=2/(window+1). Missing values restart warm-up.
adjust=True uses normalized finite-history exponential weights.

definitions.name: wma
definitions.docstring: Linearly weighted moving average, newest value has weight ``window``.

definitions.name: rma
definitions.docstring: Wilder alpha=1/window with SMA seed; NaN resets full warm-up.

source_files.docstring:
Candle geometry and explicitly parameterized pattern heuristics.

Patterns describe completed bars, not a forecast. Zero-range ratios are NaN.
Boolean patterns use pandas nullable booleans: unavailable inputs produce NA.

definitions.name: candle_features
definitions.docstring: Body/range in price units; wick ratios relative to total range; no warm-up.

definitions.name: inside_bar
definitions.docstring: Strict high<prior high and low>prior low; one-bar warm-up.

definitions.name: outside_bar
definitions.docstring: Strict high>prior high and low<prior low; one-bar warm-up.

definitions.name: engulfing
definitions.docstring: Opposite-color real-body engulfing, inclusive boundaries; excludes doji.

definitions.name: pin_bar
definitions.docstring: Long wick >= wick_ratio of range, opposite wick <= threshold; no warm-up.

definitions.name: doji
definitions.docstring: Body/range <= threshold; zero-range bars unavailable.

definitions.name: hammer_shooting_star
definitions.docstring: Geometry only, no preceding trend filter. Long wick >= factor*body.

definitions.name: morning_evening_star
definitions.docstring:
Three-bar star heuristic without mandatory Forex gaps; two-bar warm-up.

Middle body <= small_body_ratio * first body; final close penetrates
penetration of the first body's length. First/last colors must reverse.

definitions.name: marubozu
definitions.docstring: Directional candle with body/range >= threshold; no warm-up.

definitions.name: heikin_ashi
definitions.docstring: HA close=OHLC/4; initial HA open=(O+C)/2; NaN restarts state.

definitions.name: narrow_range
definitions.docstring: NR4/NR7 via window=4/7; ties count; needs window completed bars.

definitions.name: consecutive_candles
definitions.docstring: Signed run length: bullish positive, bearish negative, doji zero; NaN resets.

definitions.name: range_expansion
definitions.docstring: Current range > multiplier * mean of previous window ranges.

source_files.docstring:
Explicit local-time sessions and causal market-regime features.

Session inputs are timestamps of completed candles (availability time).
Intervals are [open, close). Session definitions are research parameters,
not assertions about a broker's calendar. DST follows the IANA timezone.

definitions.name: session_features
definitions.docstring:
Active session, local session date and elapsed minutes; no warm-up.

Overnight sessions belong to their opening date; start=end is rejected.
Elapsed minutes are actual UTC minutes, including DST transitions.
Off-session elapsed/date are NaN/NaT. Ambiguous/nonexistent opens raise.

definitions.name: session_range
definitions.docstring:
Running session H/L/range using only candles observed so far.

Off-session values are NaN. This never maps a final session extreme back
to the opening bar. Requires complete coverage from session open.

definitions.name: asia_session_range
definitions.docstring: Tokyo session wrapper, configurable local hours; running extremes.

definitions.name: london_session_range
definitions.docstring: London session wrapper; DST-aware local hours; running extremes.

definitions.name: new_york_session_range
definitions.docstring: New York session wrapper; DST-aware local hours; running extremes.

definitions.name: london_new_york_overlap
definitions.docstring: Intersection of explicitly configurable London/New York sessions.

definitions.name: opening_range_breakout
definitions.docstring:
Freeze observed range in first minutes; emit signed close breakout.

Range bars satisfy 0<=elapsed<minutes. Output levels become available at
elapsed>=minutes, signal is +1/-1/0 on each outside/inside close. If no
opening bars were observed, result is NaN; completeness is caller's duty.

definitions.name: session_vwap
definitions.docstring:
Cumulative typical-price*volume / cumulative volume per session.

volume_kind must explicitly be 'traded' or 'tick'; tick volume is only a
proxy. Zero cumulative volume yields NaN. Missing inputs poison remaining
session values; negative volume raises. No implicit unit volume fallback.

definitions.name: calendar_features
definitions.docstring: Local weekday Monday=0..Sunday=6 and hour=0..23, no warm-up.

definitions.name: weekend_gap
trend_range_regime
definitions.docstring: 1 if ADX >= threshold, 0 otherwise; NaN until ADX available.

definitions.name: volatility_regime
definitions.docstring:
1 high / 0 low NATR vs previous reference_window NATR quantile.

Current value never influences its threshold. Full historical window needed.

definitions.name: dominant_cycle
definitions.docstring:
Trailing-window analytic signal (DFT Hilbert), not centered full-series.

Detrend each completed window by OLS, select largest Fourier amplitude in
period bounds. Phase is analytic-signal phase at newest sample, radians.
Requires window samples; flat/detrended-zero windows yield NaN. Frequency
resolution is window/k; this is NOT Ehlers HT_DCPERIOD or a future forecast.

source_files.docstring: Trend indicators evaluated only after the current candle is complete.

definitions.name: adx
definitions.docstring:
Wilder movement; DI needs window+1 prices, ADX needs 2*window.

RMA uses SMA seeds. Zero TR or zero sum of directional indices produces
NaN. Missing changes restart the corresponding smoothing warm-up.

definitions.name: supertrend
definitions.docstring: ATR trailing bands, initialized bullish at first valid ATR; resets on NaN.

definitions.name: aroon
definitions.docstring: window+1 bars; newest tied extreme wins; up/down range 0..100.

definitions.name: parabolic_sar
definitions.docstring:
Wilder SAR, initial direction from two closes; output begins on bar 3.

Initial SAR is the two-bar opposite extreme. Projected SAR is clamped to
the two previous lows/highs; crossing reverses to the previous extreme.
Missing OHLC restarts the two-bar initialization.

definitions.name: ichimoku
definitions.docstring:
Causal cloud aligned to current time. No backward-shifted Chikou.

Raw spans are available now; displayed cloud uses positive displacement.
lagging_close is close.shift(displacement), a causal historical feature.

definitions.name: vortex
definitions.docstring: Sum cross-bar movement / sum TR over window changes; NaN on zero TR.

definitions.name: choppiness
definitions.docstring: 100 log10(sum(TR)/(max(H)-min(L)))/log10(window); window >= 2.

definitions.name: vhf
definitions.docstring: Close range over window / sum of window absolute changes.

definitions.name: linear_regression_slope
definitions.docstring: OLS slope in price/bar over trailing window (x=0..window-1).

definitions.name: linear_regression_channel
definitions.docstring: OLS endpoint +/- deviations * population residual std; no backpainting.

source_files.docstring: Trailing volatility estimates; annualization is supplied by the caller.

definitions.name: atr
definitions.docstring: Wilder average of true range, including first candle's high-low range.

definitions.name: natr
definitions.docstring: ATR as percentage of close; same warm-up as ATR.

definitions.name: rolling_std
definitions.docstring: Trailing standard deviation; population convention by default.

definitions.name: bollinger_bands
definitions.docstring: SMA +/- deviations * standard deviation; full-window warm-up.

definitions.name: bollinger_bandwidth
definitions.docstring: 100 * (upper-lower)/middle; zero middle returns NaN.

definitions.name: bollinger_percent_b
definitions.docstring: Fraction (close-lower)/(upper-lower); flat bands return NaN.

definitions.name: keltner_channels
definitions.docstring: Close EMA +/- multiplier * Wilder ATR, available after both warm-ups.

definitions.name: donchian_channels
definitions.docstring: Trailing extremes including current completed bar; lag=1 for prior levels.

definitions.name: historical_volatility
definitions.docstring: Annualized log-return std in fractional units; needs window+1 prices.

definitions.name: realized_volatility
definitions.docstring: sqrt(mean(log_return**2)*periods_per_year), without mean subtraction.

definitions.name: parkinson_volatility
definitions.docstring: sqrt(mean(log(H/L)^2)/(4 log(2))*annualization); needs window bars.

definitions.name: garman_klass_volatility
definitions.docstring: OHLC variance estimator; excludes overnight gaps; window-bar warm-up.
